---
title: Functions
description: Public API reference for the Cache extension
---

## Extension Entry Points

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `NewExtension(opts ...ConfigOption) forge.Extension` | Create the cache extension with functional options |
| `NewExtensionWithConfig(config Config) forge.Extension` | Same as `NewExtension(WithConfig(config))` |
| `DefaultConfig() Config` | The default configuration: in-memory, 5 minute TTL, 10,000 entries |
| `(Config) Validate() error` | The checks `Register` runs before it registers the service |

## DI Helpers

Resolve the cache from the container or the app:

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `GetCache(c forge.Container) (Cache, error)` | Resolve the cache from the DI container |
| `MustGetCache(c forge.Container) Cache` | Same as `GetCache`, but panics on error |
| `GetCacheFromApp(app forge.App) (Cache, error)` | Resolve the cache from an app |
| `MustGetCacheFromApp(app forge.App) Cache` | Same as `GetCacheFromApp`, but panics on error |

`forge.Inject[cache.Cache](c)` and `forge.Inject[*cache.CacheService](c)` work too. The service is
also registered under the name in `ServiceKey` (`"cache"`).

## Cache Interface

Implemented by `*CacheService` and `*InMemoryCache`:

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `Connect(ctx) error` | Connect the backend. The extension calls it on start |
| `Disconnect(ctx) error` | Disconnect and release resources. The in-memory store is emptied |
| `Ping(ctx) error` | `nil` when connected, `ErrNotConnected` otherwise |
| `Get(ctx, key) ([]byte, error)` | Read a value. `ErrNotFound` when missing or expired |
| `Set(ctx, key, value, ttl) error` | Store a copy of `value`. `ttl == 0` uses `DefaultTTL` |
| `Delete(ctx, key) error` | Remove a key. A missing key is not an error |
| `Exists(ctx, key) (bool, error)` | Whether a live entry exists |
| `Clear(ctx) error` | Remove every entry |
| `Keys(ctx, pattern) ([]string, error)` | List live keys matching a glob with at most one `*` (for example `user:*`) |
| `TTL(ctx, key) (time.Duration, error)` | Time left, or `0` for an entry that never expires |
| `Expire(ctx, key, ttl) error` | Set a new TTL. `ttl <= 0` makes the entry permanent |

## StringCache Interface

Implemented by the in-memory backend. Reach it through `CacheService.Cache()` and a type assertion.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `GetString(ctx, key) (string, error)` | Read a value as a string |
| `SetString(ctx, key, value, ttl) error` | Store a string |

## JSONCache Interface

Implemented by the in-memory backend. Reach it the same way as `StringCache`.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `GetJSON(ctx, key, target any) error` | Unmarshal a cached value into `target` |
| `SetJSON(ctx, key, value any, ttl) error` | Marshal `value` as JSON and store it |

## CounterCache Interface

Declared, but no backend implements it yet.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `Incr(ctx, key) (int64, error)` | Increment by 1 |
| `IncrBy(ctx, key, value int64) (int64, error)` | Increment by `value` |
| `Decr(ctx, key) (int64, error)` | Decrement by 1 |
| `DecrBy(ctx, key, value int64) (int64, error)` | Decrement by `value` |

## MultiCache Interface

Declared, but no backend implements it yet.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `MGet(ctx, keys ...string) ([][]byte, error)` | Read several keys |
| `MSet(ctx, kvs map[string][]byte, ttl) error` | Write several keys with one TTL |
| `MDelete(ctx, keys ...string) error` | Delete several keys |

## CacheService

`*CacheService` wraps a backend, implements `Cache` by delegating to it, and adds:

| Function or method | Description |
|---|---|
| `NewCacheService(config, logger, metrics) (*CacheService, error)` | Validate the config and build the backend. Fails for `redis` and `memcached` |
| `Cache() Cache` | The underlying backend, for type assertions to `StringCache` or `JSONCache` |
| `Name() string` | Returns `"cache-service"` |
| `Start(ctx) error` | Connect the backend |
| `Stop(ctx) error` | Disconnect the backend. Logs a disconnect error and returns `nil` |
| `Health(ctx) error` | Ping the backend |

## In-Memory Backend

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `NewInMemoryCache(config, logger, metrics) *InMemoryCache` | Build the in-memory backend directly. A zero `DefaultTTL` or `CleanupInterval` falls back to 5 minutes or 1 minute |
